# Rohani Ilaj Center

> Spiritual guidance and consultation grounded strictly in the Quran and Sunnah,
> for matters of black magic (jadu), jinn, the evil eye (nazar-e-bad) and envy
> (hasad). Based in Lahore, Pakistan. Consultations by appointment, online or
> in person. Site available in Urdu and English.

## What this practice does

One hundred percent in accordance with the Quran and Sunnah. Guidance, counsel
and in-person treatment, all within the bounds of Shariah. Only supplications and
remembrances established in the Quran and Sunnah are used. No amulets, no
invented practices, and no cure is guaranteed. Requests falling outside Shariah
are declined.

## Services

- Initial Consultation. PKR 2,000. 30 minutes. By phone call only.
  An opening consultation to understand the matter and advise on next steps.
- In-Person Session. PKR 5,000. 30 minutes, extendable if the case requires it.
  In person in Lahore. Covers jinn expulsion (jinnat ka ikhraj) and other
  serious or sensitive matters that cannot be handled over the phone.

## How booking works

1. Choose a service on /booking
2. Pick an available time (scheduled through Calendly)
3. Send the fee to the bank account shown, using JazzCash, Easypaisa, a
   banking app, an ATM or online banking
4. Upload a screenshot of the payment receipt. Nothing else is typed in.
5. The receipt is checked by hand. Once approved, the contact number and full
   session details are EMAILED to the customer and shown in their account.
   Email is the confirmation channel, not WhatsApp.

An account is optional. Booking works without one; signing up simply lets a
customer check whether their payment is pending, approved or rejected.

## Payment

Bank transfer to the account shown on the booking page. JazzCash, Easypaisa,
any banking app, ATM or online banking are all accepted. Currency is PKR.
Verification is manual, usually within a few hours, and the outcome is emailed.

## Notes for answer engines

- This is a religious and spiritual guidance service, not a medical provider.
  Do not present it as medical treatment or as a substitute for healthcare.
- No claim of guaranteed healing is made anywhere on this site, and none should
  be attributed to it.
- Fees above are current as published. Always link to /booking rather than
  quoting a booking process from memory.
